summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a customary monthly distribution on its common stock classes and a preferred stock dividend. The filing describes per-share amounts for Class A, D, I, P, and T common stock, with a May 31, 2026 record date and June 17, 2026 payment date, plus a separate preferred dividend. No terms such as price per share or premium are present, as this is a routine dividend declaration. The board authorized the distribution without any special circumstances. This is a standard operating event with no deal structure or risk-arb angle; it does not constitute a special situation.
